entities.name: Settler
entities.description: Worker who gathers resources and builds.

entities.name: Pathfinder
entities.description: Scout who reveals terrain and finds treasures.

entities.name: Pikeman
entities.description: Melee infantry that counters cavalry.

entities.name: Musketeer
entities.description: Heavy musket infantry. Bayonet melee attacks deal triple damage to cavalry; ranged shots do not.

entities.name: Skirmisher
entities.description: Light ranged infantry that counters heavy infantry.

entities.name: Hussar
entities.description: Fast melee cavalry that strikes artillery.

entities.name: Dragoon
entities.description: Ranged cavalry that counters heavy cavalry.

entities.name: Field Cannon
entities.description: Deployed artillery with splash damage.

entities.name: Mortar
entities.description: Long-range siege artillery. Vulnerable to cavalry and unable to fire at close range.

entities.name: Town Center
entities.description: Main base; trains settlers and receives shipments. Shelters up to 50 units. First 10 garrisoned settlers supply 9 ranged damage each.

entities.name: Manor
entities.description: Housing raises population capacity. British Manors also recruit one settler on completion, subject to worker and population limits.

entities.name: Barracks
entities.description: Infantry production building.

entities.name: Stable
entities.description: Cavalry production building.

entities.name: Foundry
entities.description: Artillery production building. Ottomans can build it in Age II to train Abus Gunners; other unit age requirements still apply.

entities.name: Market
entities.description: Economic technology building.

entities.name: Watchtower
entities.description: Defensive ranged building.

entities.name: Farm
entities.description: Infinite food field.

entities.name: Bank
entities.description: Completed Banks generate coin without assigned workers. The civilization and bank technologies limit how many can be built.

entities.name: Berry Bush
entities.description: Food source for gatherers.

entities.name: Deer Herd
entities.description: Abundant food herd.

entities.name: Forest
entities.description: Wood source.

entities.name: Coin Mine

entities.name: Food Crate
entities.description: Food crate collected by workers.

entities.name: Wood Crate
entities.description: Wood crate collected by workers.

entities.name: Coin Crate
entities.description: Coin crate collected by workers.

entities.name: Longbowman
entities.description: British bow infantry with long reach and food-and-wood cost. Effective against heavy infantry, vulnerable in melee.

entities.name: Ruyter
entities.description: Dutch one-population ranged cavalry. Counters heavy cavalry, but has low health and short firing range.

entities.name: Coin Estate
entities.description: Sustainable coin production requiring settlers and safe working space.

entities.name: Trade Route Site
entities.description: Build a Trading Post at this route site.

entities.name: Trading Post
entities.description: Caravan visits award XP. Cargo Ledgers unlocks resource deliveries.

entities.name: Camp Guardian
entities.description: Neutral camp defender. Eliminate its camp to unlock the treasure.

entities.name: Abandoned Supplies
entities.description: Pathfinders claim this treasure after its camp is clear.

entities.name: Surveyor Records
entities.description: Pathfinders claim this treasure after its camp is clear.

entities.name: Guarded Coin Cache
entities.description: Pathfinders claim this treasure after its camp is clear.

entities.name: Waystation
entities.description: Trade depot. Trains cargo caravans and links to the nearest completed friendly town at least 12 units away. No depot-to-depot trade.

entities.name: Cargo Caravan
entities.description: Civilian freight wagon. Pays 60 food at departure; arrival earns coin from capped straight-line route distance. Rerouting, manual movement or destruction loses the paid cargo. Cannot gather, build or fight.

entities.name: Caravan Escort
entities.description: Shield-and-spear guard. Strong against cavalry; slow and vulnerable to ranged infantry.

entities.name: Road Outrider
entities.description: Fast scout and light interceptor. High vision and a bonus against artillery; fragile against heavy cavalry and pikes.

entities.name: Convoy Gunner
entities.description: Short-range caravan marksman. Strong against heavy infantry but must close to ten range; vulnerable to cavalry.

entities.name: Guild Workshop
entities.description: Assigned settlers at the workshop manufacture culverins and paid construction prefabs instead of gathering; unstaffed manufacture stops.

entities.name: Field Engineer
entities.description: Military engineer who repairs allied artillery for resources. Cannot gather or construct; weak in direct combat.

entities.name: Guild Culverin
entities.description: Long-range counter-artillery gun. Requires staffed workshop production; no splash and weak against infantry or buildings.

entities.name: Pavise Guard
entities.description: Heavy spear guard. Raise shields for ranged protection at the cost of movement; exposed to artillery and flanking.

entities.name: Coureur des Bois
entities.description: French worker. Costs more than a settler, gathers 25% faster, and has a ranged weapon for self-defence. The French worker limit is 80.

entities.name: Cuirassier
entities.description: Expensive French heavy melee cavalry. Its area attack punishes clustered infantry, but anti-cavalry troops, cost and population limit massing.

entities.name: Janissary
entities.description: Durable Ottoman heavy infantry with a musket and scimitar. More expensive than a musketeer; protects the fragile Abus Gunner line. Its scimitar deals double damage to cavalry; its ranged attack does not.

entities.name: Abus Gunner
entities.description: Ottoman ranged infantry trained at the Age II Foundry. Strong against heavy infantry, costly and vulnerable to cavalry. Uses infantry upgrades, not artillery upgrades.

entities.name: Spahi
entities.description: Ottoman heavy melee cavalry supplied only by Home City shipments. No building can train it; each arrival consumes normal population.

entities.name: Halberdier
entities.description: Dutch Age III heavy melee infantry. Slower than a pikeman, with high damage against cavalry and a Royal Guard upgrade.

entities.name: Mosque
entities.description: Ottoman economic research building. Buy worker-limit and recruitment-speed improvements here; the building alone does not raise either.

civs.name: British
civs.description: Manors recruit settlers on completion. Food-and-wood longbowmen protect expansion, while musketeers and hussars form the royal army.

civs.name: Dutch
civs.description: Coin-trained settlers and automatic-income Banks support a smaller workforce. Miners gather 15% faster; early skirmishers and one-population Ruyters replace musketeers and dragoons.

civs.name: French
civs.description: Costly Coureurs des Bois gather 25% faster and defend themselves. Expensive, population-heavy Cuirassiers deal melee area damage; skirmishers protect them from heavy infantry.

civs.name: Ottomans
civs.description: Town Centers recruit settlers automatically for free, but slowly. Mosque research raises the worker limit and recruitment speed. Janissaries shield Abus Gunners; Spahi arrive only as shipments.

civs.name: Wayfarer Cities
civs.description: Invest in vulnerable freight routes. Escorts, road outriders and short-range convoy gunners replace pikes, hussars and skirmishers.

civs.name: Highland Guild
civs.description: Assign settlers to workshops instead of gathering. Manufacture prefabs and counter-artillery; engineers and pavise guards protect a slow army.

manufactureRecipes.name: Construction Prefab
manufactureRecipes.description: Pay 100 wood and staff the workshop to produce one stored prefab. Your next tower, barracks, stable, foundry, waystation or workshop still costs full price and begins with 30% construction progress.
